text: Yingnao（硬脑）是供 DSH 使用的本地硬盘索引工具插件，面向 web、TUI、桌面及命令行宿主。它通过注册六个工具连接本机 Yingnao HTTP 服务，让 Agent 先查看文件覆盖和处理质量，再按关键词或文件名、路径搜索，查看单个文件正文与质量信息，并从一份文件发现语义相关材料。插件还可查询治理作业和进度，或提交允许的作业；需确认的任务会等待用户确认。适合从个人磁盘资料中找文件、整理素材和了解索引状态的用户。需要预先运行本地 Yingnao 服务，不需要 API Key。

Yingnao (硬脑) connects DSH to a local disk index. Six tools let an agent review coverage, search and inspect files, find semantically related material, and check or submit governance jobs. Some jobs wait for user confirmation. Requires the local Yingnao service; no API key.
我想从本机硬盘里按内容找文件。
DSH 能先告诉我磁盘索引覆盖了多少吗？
帮我从一份资料找到同主题的其他文件。
我想检查某个文件的正文和提取质量。
怎么查看本地文件索引里有哪些内容还没处理？
能不能让 Agent 查询和跟踪文件整理作业？
Find a file in my locally indexed disk by its contents.
Show me files that are semantically related to this document.
Yingnao 的功能「盘点索引状态」：调用 yingnao_overview 汇总文件数量、状态分布、可用正文质量、年份和顶层目录，帮助判断资料库从哪里开始整理。
Yingnao 的功能「搜索本地文件」：使用 yingnao_search 按查询词搜索正文，也可按目录和扩展名筛选；默认混合正文、文件名和路径匹配，并说明命中类型。
Yingnao 的功能「发现相关文件」：提供一个 file_id 后调用 yingnao_related，按语义相似度列出相关材料，便于从一份锚点资料继续扩展检索。
Yingnao 的功能「检查文件内容」：调用 yingnao_inspect 查看指定文件的元数据、正文片段、质量判定和向量可用状态，便于引用前核对材料。
Yingnao 的功能「查询或提交作业」：yingnao_govern 可查询作业状态和日志；配置允许时可提交治理作业，需用户确认的作业会保持排队并提示确认。
Yingnao 通过 HTTP 请求把查询及文件索引返回内容交给本机服务处理；默认连接 127.0.0.1:5050，使用前需先启动 Yingnao。

dsh-yingnao README · dsh-yingnao：Bring **Yingnao (硬脑)** into [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness).

Yingnao indexes a **local disk**: your files never move, only the index goes into a database.
With this plugin your DSH agent can see how much of that disk is still dark, search it,
follow semantic neighbours to material you'd never think to search for, and **dispatch
governance jobs** — instead of only reading dashboards.

dsh-yingnao README · dsh-yingnao：> Requires Yingnao running locally. <https://github.com/qiuyiwu1989-star/yingnao>
> No API key: it manages your own machine. The UI and returned content are in Chinese.

dsh-yingnao README · Install：```sh
npx -p @deepseek-ai/dsh dsh plugin --profile web add github:qiuyiwu1989-star/dsh-yingnao
```

Build output ships in the repository, so no dependency build scripts need to be allowed.
Restart the profile afterwards.

Start Yingnao's index service (the desktop client does this for you, or run `python3 app.py`).
The plugin talks to `http://127.0.0.1:5050` by default.

dsh-yingnao README · Six tools：Yingnao's HTTP surface has a dozen-odd endpoints. This plugin registers 6 — **a client's job
is not to mirror the server, it is to present the right shape.** Hand a model a long list of
endpoint names and its default strategy becomes "call whichever returns the most", which blows
up its own context before it can think about which tool it should have used.

dsh-yingnao README · Six tools：| Tool | When to use it |
|---|---|
| `yingnao_overview` | **First step, before governing anything.** How much of the disk is still dark, and how much of what's "processed" is actually usable |
| `yingnao_search` | Find files. **Degrades rather than fails** — files with no extractable text still match on name and path, and say so |
| `yingnao_related` | Take one file, find what's semantically near it. **Measurably the most reliable capability here** |
| `yingnao_inspect` | One file's metadata, body text and quality verdict. Check this before quoting anything |
| `yingnao_govern` | Dispatch a governance job, or check progress. **This is the hand — and it has a boundary** |
| `yingnao_call` | **Escape hatch**, not the main road |

dsh-yingnao README · Why `related` beats `search` here：Measured on a real 76k-file archive:

```
file → file   0.819   two decks genuinely on one thread
query → file  0.639   a good hit
query → file  0.609   a clear miss (matched someone else's memoir)
```

dsh-yingnao README · Why `related` beats `search` here：File-to-file scores run high because both sides are whole documents; a one-sentence query
carries far less signal. So **the same 0.639 is a good result in search and a weak one in
related** — the plugin uses two separate vocabularies rather than one shared threshold,
because sharing one would mislead both the model and the user.

dsh-yingnao README · Why `related` beats `search` here：The practical upshot for an agent: when gathering material, `search` for one anchor document,
then `related` outward. That surfaces the drafts and earlier versions you would never have
thought to query for.

dsh-yingnao README · The boundary on `yingnao_govern`：Two classes of governance action are **not the agent's to decide**:

- ones that **cost money** (OCR re-extraction, LLM labelling)
- ones that **move the user's real files** (inbox archiving)

Yingnao marks these `needs_confirm`. Dispatching one only queues it — it will not run until
the user confirms in the desktop client. The tool says so plainly rather than reporting success.

dsh-yingnao README · The boundary on `yingnao_govern`：Everything else (quality checks, codepoint normalisation) runs immediately and is reversible:
those jobs write a full backup manifest before touching anything.

If you don't want the agent able to dispatch anything at all, set `allowGovern: false` and
`yingnao_govern` degrades to read-only.

- insert:
    - id: yingnao
      name: 'dsh-yingnao'
      config:

`YINGNAO_ENDPOINT` overrides the endpoint if you'd rather not put it in config.

dsh-yingnao README · Errors are classified so the model can act on them：Not a stack trace — a sentence the model can change its behaviour on:

| Kind | What the model should do |
|---|---|
| `offline` | Yingnao isn't running. **Retrying won't help** — tell the user to open it |
| `tunnel` | Service is up but can't reach the database. May recover; retry once later |
| `notfound` | Change the argument, don't retry as-is |
| `server` | Retry once; if it keeps failing, tell the user |

dsh-yingnao README · Pairs with `dsh-deepbrain`：Install both and one agent holds two complementary layers: **judgments** with evidence chains
from [DeepBrain](https://github.com/qiuyiwu1989-star/dsh-deepbrain), and the **raw material**
those judgments came from, sitting on your own disk.

> "Write me a piece on creativity education" → pull what you've said on it across meetings
> from DeepBrain → pull the source decks and drafts from Yingnao → write from both.
